title: Heroes of Faith
intro: Hebrews chapter 11 is often called the "hall of fame of faith" - a list of people who lived by faith in God's promises.

heroes.name: Abel
heroes.deed: Offered a better sacrifice than Cain

heroes.name: Enoch
heroes.deed: Was taken up without seeing death

heroes.name: Abraham
heroes.deed: Went out not knowing where he was going

heroes.name: Sarah
heroes.deed: Received power to become a mother in old age

heroes.name: Isaac
heroes.deed: Blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come

heroes.name: Jacob
heroes.deed: Blessed Joseph's sons and worshiped while leaning on his staff

heroes.name: Joseph
heroes.deed: Spoke about the exodus and gave instructions regarding his bones

heroes.name: Moses
heroes.deed: Left Egypt and kept the Passover

heroes.name: Gideon
heroes.deed: Mentioned among those who conquered by faith

heroes.name: Samson
heroes.deed: Mentioned among those who conquered by faith

heroes.name: David
heroes.deed: Mentioned among those who conquered by faith

heroes.name: Samuel
heroes.deed: Mentioned among the prophets who lived by faith
